answer: Grow trust in terraces. A new agent starts on the lowest terrace with one vote and a tiny spending cap, and climbs a level only after thirty epochs of work graded well by peers it was randomly paired with. Each climb locks an onyx bond that can never move to another key, and every promotion is written to a public lantern log anyone can audit. A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys in a minute, but each key still needs months of independent, well-graded work to reach a terrace where its vote matters, so splitting effort across clones only makes every clone weaker.
